```{=html}
<header class="c-pagehead">
  <div class="c-wrap">
<h1>Research</h1>
    <p>
      One question — how disease arises, spreads and is best treated in Bangladesh —
      approached at four scales. Each group owns a scale; projects usually cross
      two or more.
    </p>
  </div>
</header>

<section class="c-slab c-slab--paper">
  <div class="c-wrap">
    <div class="c-axis">
      <div class="c-axis-row">
        <div class="c-axis-step">
          <span class="c-axis-scale">Molecular</span>
          <span class="c-axis-label">Molecules &amp; genomes</span>
        </div>
        <div class="c-axis-step">
          <span class="c-axis-scale">Individual</span>
          <span class="c-axis-label">Patients &amp; records</span>
        </div>
        <div class="c-axis-step">
          <span class="c-axis-scale">Predictive</span>
          <span class="c-axis-label">Models &amp; diagnostics</span>
        </div>
        <div class="c-axis-step">
          <span class="c-axis-scale">Population</span>
          <span class="c-axis-label">Districts &amp; climate</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="c-div-grid">
      <article class="c-card">
        <h3>Computational Biology</h3>
        <p>Computational drug discovery across the pipeline — discovery biology, human genetics, medicinal chemistry, protein sciences, DMPK and clinical development.</p>
        <a class="c-card-link" href="../groups/combio/">Open group →</a>
      </article>
      <article class="c-card">
        <h3>Public Health &amp; Informatics</h3>
        <p>Epidemiological surveillance, national survey analytics, digital health evaluation and evidence synthesis for health policy.</p>
        <a class="c-card-link" href="../groups/public-health-informatics/">Open group →</a>
      </article>
      <article class="c-card">
        <h3>Bio-AI</h3>
        <p>Clinical risk prediction, biomedical image analysis, interpretable models and biomarker discovery pipelines.</p>
        <a class="c-card-link" href="../groups/bio-ai/">Open group →</a>
      </article>
      <article class="c-card">
        <h3>Geospatial Health</h3>
        <p>Spatial epidemiology, earth observation, healthcare accessibility modelling and environmental health risk mapping.</p>
        <a class="c-card-link" href="../groups/geospatial-health/">Open group →</a>
      </article>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="c-slab c-slab--white">
  <div class="c-wrap">
    <div class="c-slab-head">
      <span class="c-eyebrow">How a project runs</span>
      <h2 class="c-h2">From question to publication</h2>
      <p class="c-lede">
        Every project follows the same route, because the route is the thing we are
        teaching. Students join at step one, not at the analysis.
      </p>
    </div>

    <div class="c-grid-4">
      <div class="c-card">
        <span class="c-card-meta">Stage 01</span>
        <h3>Question &amp; protocol</h3>
        <p>Literature review, a written hypothesis, and a pre-specified analysis plan before any data is touched.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="c-card">
        <span class="c-card-meta">Stage 02</span>
        <h3>Data &amp; code</h3>
        <p>Reproducible pipelines in R or Python, version-controlled in the open from the first commit.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="c-card">
        <span class="c-card-meta">Stage 03</span>
        <h3>Interpretation</h3>
        <p>Weekly review with a supervisor, adversarial reading of the result, and figures built to be understood.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="c-card">
        <span class="c-card-meta">Stage 04</span>
        <h3>Peer review</h3>
        <p>Manuscript drafting, submission and revision, with the student as first author.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="c-slab c-slab--panel">
  <div class="c-wrap">
    <div class="c-slab-head">
      <span class="c-eyebrow">Work with us</span>
      <h2 class="c-h2">Bring us a problem</h2>
      <p class="c-lede">
        We take on collaborations with laboratories, hospitals, universities and
        non-profits — usually contributing computational analysis to a study that
        already has the domain expertise and the data.
      </p>
    </div>
    <div class="c-btn-row">
      <a class="c-btn c-btn--solid" href="../collaborators/">Collaboration</a>
      <a class="c-btn c-btn--ghost" href="../publications/">See our outputs</a>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
```
